description: UCSC hg38 (GRCh38) chr21 reference FASTA, used for N-content screening of candidate windows and as independent coordinate cross-check

HPRC release2 PGGB pangenome graph, chromosome-level GFA for chr21 (p98-k311 params), includes GRCh38 and CHM13 as reference paths plus 464 HPRC year-2 haplotypes; not fully QC'd/published per hpp_pangenome_resources repo
